correctness.rationale: Every point of the section has independent pivot columns in distinct paired blocks; the entire pivot chart is A² times m−2 disjoint 2×2 determinant cones. Such cones are integral and Cohen–Macaulay, singular only at zero (Jacobian variables d,−c,−b,a, valid char2), so X_m is an lci, normal by R1+S2, and local singular support equals zero pair projections. Smooth incidence Gr_B(2,⊕ line bundles) over (P1)^m supplies irreducibility of the support; reduced charts yield integral scheme. Each zero-block locus is X_(m−1); intersections delete pairs, formal smooth nonzero-block factors and independent determinant nodes yield exact local normal form at z zero blocks. Regular hyperplane section has Plücker degree Gr(2,2m) Catalan and components corresponding lower Catalan. Independent symbolic determinant/Jacobian check corroborated the local chart; general proof is geometric, not finite enumeration.
